name: Capacitor production line solution
summary: A complete line automation solution for capacitor manufacturers, covering winding, assembly, sealing, aging, and final inspection and packaging.
contentHtml:
The capacitor production line solution is a complete line automation solution provided by TXAM for capacitor manufacturers.

Solution Composition

The complete line covers the entire process including winding, assembly, impregnation, sealing, aging test, appearance inspection, performance test, and automatic packaging.

Technical Advantages

  • High-speed precision winding, with winding accuracy reaching industry-leading levels
  • Automated assembly, reducing manual intervention and improving consistency
  • Vacuum impregnation system, ensuring stable insulation performance
  • Intelligent aging test, significantly improving test efficiency
  • Vision inspection system, with high defect recognition accuracy
  • Moisture-proof packaging system, ensuring product storage life

Service Content

TXAM provides full-process support from solution design, equipment manufacturing, installation and commissioning to after-sales service.
